items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Alive Wilson. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, he played quite well I would say.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, he found a good one. That's great. And Andrew Anderson, he plays, you don't hear too much. He has such a soft tune. That's the reason why Gorman liked him so much. He liked that kind of soft. You don't hear too much from him but he's playing good though. Who else was, that was not a trumpet player. Yeah, Baptiste and his English player.
Yeah, he played quite well I would say. And Manipole is the guy who does the best, keeps the band going best.
